description:
Digital Wellbeing (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.wellbeing)
Lets you track device and app usage and set usage limits.
WARNING: It is now a hard dependency for the Settings app on Android 12+ for Pixel phones. After uninstalling, there will be an empty entry on Settings. Rebooting should make it disappear..
